Retrieves details for a lookalike domain based on the specified ID
GET
https://api.zsapi.net/easm/easm-ui/v1/organizations/:orgId/lookalike-domains/:lookalikeRaw/details

Retrieves details for a lookalike domain based on the specified ID. To learn more, see Understanding Lookalike Domain Details.

Request
​
PATH PARAMETERS
orgId
string
REQUIRED

Identifier extracted from the path. Renamed automatically; review the description and tighten the schema if needed.

lookalikeRaw
string
REQUIRED

Identifier extracted from the path. Renamed automatically; review the description and tighten the schema if needed.

HEADER PARAMETERS
Authorization
string
REQUIRED

API authentication token

Default value: Bearer your-token

400

500

OK
